text: I had to go to the grocery store on Monday. I had to make sure I got some meat as well as some bread for the week. When I got there, I also ended up getting some bananas, some potatoes, and some canned beans, all of which were on sale so I could afford them. At least for the beans and potatoes they will at least last for a little bit in storage. I ended up getting 1 loaf of bread and 6 pork chops as well to complete my trip.
